## Description
Provide a concise explanation of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] Code builds without errors (`pnpm run build`)
- [ ] TypeScript typecheck passes (`pnpm run typecheck`)
- [ ] Linter and format checks pass (`pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check`)
- [ ] Added tests covering success, failure, and edge cases
- [ ] All tests pass locally (`pnpm test`)
- [ ] Updated documentation (README, architecture, or wave issues) if applicable
